changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE course SET course_icon = CONCAT('courses/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 14) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 14)) - 1), '/icons/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 14) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 14)) + 1)) WHERE course_icon LIKE 'course/icons/%/%' AND course_icon NOT LIKE 'course/icons/%/%/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(course_icon) <= 254;
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE course SET course_icon = CONCAT('course/icons/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 9) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 9)) - 1), '/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 9) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 9)) + 7)) WHERE course_icon LIKE 'courses/%/icons/%' AND course_icon NOT LIKE 'courses/%/icons/%/%';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE jhi_user SET image_url = CONCAT('users/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(image_url FROM 23) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(image_url FROM 23)) - 1), '/profile-pictures/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(image_url FROM 23) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(image_url FROM 23)) + 1)) WHERE image_url LIKE 'user/profile-pictures/%/%' AND image_url NOT LIKE 'user/profile-pictures/%/%/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(image_url) <= 255;
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE jhi_user SET image_url = CONCAT('user/profile-pictures/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(image_url FROM 7) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(image_url FROM 7)) - 1), '/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(image_url FROM 7) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(image_url FROM 7)) + 18)) WHERE image_url LIKE 'users/%/profile-pictures/%' AND image_url NOT LIKE 'users/%/profile-pictures/%/%';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE exam_user SET signing_image_path = CONCAT('exam-users/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(signing_image_path FROM 22) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(signing_image_path FROM 22)) - 1), '/signatures/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(signing_image_path FROM 22) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(signing_image_path FROM 22)) + 1)) WHERE signing_image_path LIKE 'exam-user/signatures/%/%' AND signing_image_path NOT LIKE 'exam-user/signatures/%/%/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(signing_image_path) <= 99;
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE exam_user SET signing_image_path = CONCAT('exam-user/signatures/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(signing_image_path FROM 12) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(signing_image_path FROM 12)) - 1), '/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(signing_image_path FROM 12) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(signing_image_path FROM 12)) + 12)) WHERE signing_image_path LIKE 'exam-users/%/signatures/%' AND signing_image_path NOT LIKE 'exam-users/%/signatures/%/%';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Exam user images: exam-user/{examUserId}/{file} becomes exam-users/{examUserId}/{file}. A signature path also starts with exam-user/ but carries one more slash, so the second guard keeps it out (it never lands in this column anyway).
changeSet.sql: UPDATE exam_user SET student_image_path = CONCAT('exam-users/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(student_image_path FROM 11) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(student_image_path FROM 11)) - 1), '/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(student_image_path FROM 11) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(student_image_path FROM 11)) + 1)) WHERE student_image_path LIKE 'exam-user/%/%' AND student_image_path NOT LIKE 'exam-user/%/%/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(student_image_path) <= 99;
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE exam_user SET student_image_path = CONCAT('exam-user/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(student_image_path FROM 12) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(student_image_path FROM 12)) - 1), '/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(student_image_path FROM 12) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(student_image_path FROM 12)) + 1)) WHERE student_image_path LIKE 'exam-users/%/%' AND student_image_path NOT LIKE 'exam-users/%/%/%';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question SET background_file_path = CONCAT('drag-and-drop/questions/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(background_file_path FROM 27) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(background_file_path FROM 27)) - 1), '/backgrounds/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(background_file_path FROM 27) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(background_file_path FROM 27)) + 1)) WHERE background_file_path LIKE 'drag-and-drop/backgrounds/%/%' AND background_file_path NOT LIKE 'drag-and-drop/backgrounds/%/%/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(background_file_path) <= 245;
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE quiz_question SET background_file_path = CONCAT('drag-and-drop/backgrounds/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(background_file_path FROM 25) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(background_file_path FROM 25)) - 1), '/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(background_file_path FROM 25) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(background_file_path FROM 25)) + 13)) WHERE background_file_path LIKE 'drag-and-drop/questions/%/backgrounds/%' AND background_file_path NOT LIKE 'drag-and-drop/questions/%/backgrounds/%/%';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Lecture attachments: attachments/lecture/... becomes attachments/lectures/... . The canonical spelling does not match the guard, so re-running the changeset is a no-op.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment SET jhi_link = CONCAT('attachments/lectures/', SUBSTRING(jhi_link FROM 21)) WHERE jhi_link LIKE 'attachments/lecture/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(jhi_link) <= 254;

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Attachment video unit files: attachments/attachment-unit/... becomes attachments/attachment-video-units/... .
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment SET jhi_link = CONCAT('attachments/attachment-video-units/', SUBSTRING(jhi_link FROM 29)) WHERE jhi_link LIKE 'attachments/attachment-unit/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(jhi_link) <= 248;

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Student versions of attachment video unit files, same re-spelling as the link above.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment SET student_version = CONCAT('attachments/attachment-video-units/', SUBSTRING(student_version FROM 29)) WHERE student_version LIKE 'attachments/attachment-unit/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(student_version) <= 248;

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Slide images, same re-spelling. slide_image_path is the narrowest of these columns (150), so it is also the one most likely to leave rows behind on the length guard.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE slide SET slide_image_path = CONCAT('attachments/attachment-video-units/', SUBSTRING(slide_image_path FROM 29)) WHERE slide_image_path LIKE 'attachments/attachment-unit/%' AND CHAR_LENGTH(slide_image_path) <= 143;

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question SET content = REPLACE(CAST(content AS CHAR), 'drag-and-drop/drag-items/', CONCAT('drag-and-drop/questions/', id, '/drag-items/')) WHERE discriminator = 'DD' AND CAST(content AS CHAR) LIKE '%drag-and-drop/drag-items/%';
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE quiz_question SET content = REPLACE(CAST(content AS CHAR), CONCAT('drag-and-drop/questions/', id, '/drag-items/'), 'drag-and-drop/drag-items/') WHERE discriminator = 'DD' AND CAST(content AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%drag-and-drop/questions/', id, '/drag-items/%');

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question SET content = CAST(REPLACE(CAST(content AS TEXT), 'drag-and-drop/drag-items/', CONCAT('drag-and-drop/questions/', id, '/drag-items/')) AS JSONB) WHERE discriminator = 'DD' AND CAST(content AS TEXT) LIKE '%drag-and-drop/drag-items/%';
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE quiz_question SET content = CAST(REPLACE(CAST(content AS TEXT), CONCAT('drag-and-drop/questions/', id, '/drag-items/'), 'drag-and-drop/drag-items/') AS JSONB) WHERE discriminator = 'DD' AND CAST(content AS TEXT) LIKE CONCAT('%drag-and-drop/questions/', id, '/drag-items/%');
